findings.summary: The control panel's left footer now reads '1 shadow nodes change' (frame-146-diverted.png), so a count of one is printed with a plural noun. The number is legible and the panel reads correctly; only the agreement is wrong, and it appears in one of the nine figures.

method: each figure judged from its nine named rendered PNGs only; no SVG and no other image was opened. Refused-ring counts were measured from the PNG pixels by ring-coverage detection (a hollow ring scoring withheld here is drawn at r=5 px for ms=6 and r=13.8 px for the ms=16 ring that encloses the coincident star), cross-checked against each panel's own printed footer.
raw_text: Rubric lines and findings below; the prior round's three blocking marker findings are answered at this head (see reconciliation and summary).

reconciliation.method: per panel, count of hollow refused rings visible in the refused circles = plain ms=6 rings + the ms=16 ring enclosing the single source-cutoff star; a ring is accepted at 0.90 angular coverage at its own radius. Detections at a filled star core and detections off the support-cell lattice (half-spacing artefacts between overlapping rings) are excluded and named per panel.

summary: All nine named PNGs were opened and judged from the rendered pixels. The prior round's three blocking findings are answered: in each of the five regenerated poloidal panels the refused marks now reconcile with their own footers (5, 9, 43, 9 and 96 cells; the converged control still shows none), because the cell that coincides with the source-cutoff star is drawn with its own larger ring around the star and the coincidence is explained in a footer note. The circled star is legible in all five panels, the star is not obscured by its ring, and the wall, both null sets and the solved and EFIT contours remain readable. One new non-blocking finding is recorded: the control panel's left footer reads '1 shadow nodes change', a plural noun with a count of one. The remaining non-blocking points carried from the prior round (white margin around the poloidal panels, the 347-cell grey lattice outweighing the contours, the dense refused band in the suppressed panel, and the untagged peak tick in the limited-trajectory field panel) are unchanged rather than worse, so they are not re-raised here.
